title: Asian stocks steady as AI, Middle East jitters recede
paragraphs: Asian stocks steady as AI, Middle East jitters recede

Asian markets and US equity futures made a steady start on Monday (Nov 9), after a wild week where doubts about demand for computer chips sent tech-heavy markets in Asia into some of their steepest falls in years.

HONG KONG: Asian markets and US equity futures made a steady start on Monday (Nov 9), wobbling into positive territory after a wild week where doubts about demand for computer chips sent tech-heavy markets in Asia into some of their steepest falls in years.
